description.narrative: This activity Help least developed countries to negotiate international investment agreements. is a component of Investment and sustainable development programme. reported by FCDO with a funding type of 111 - Not for profit organisation and a budget of £1,500,000. This project benefits Developing countries, unspecified. It works in the following sector(s): Trade policy and administrative management.
